question: Who is the current CEO of Titan Company, and when did they take the role?
answer: Titan Company does not list a company-wide officer with the title “Chief Executive Officer”; its current Managing Director is Ajoy Chawla. He took the role on January 1, 2026, succeeding C. K. Venkataraman.

retrieval.query: site.titancompany.in leadership current managing director chief executive officer Titan Company
retrieval.text:
**Titan Company Limited’s current Managing Director is Mr. Ajoy Chawla.** ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/leadership-team?utm_source=openai))

Titan does **not** list one company-wide officer titled simply “Chief Executive Officer” on its leadership page. Its business-division CEOs include:

- **Mr. Arun Narayan** — Chief Executive Officer, Jewellery  
- **Mr. Kuruvilla Markose** — Chief Executive Officer, Watches  
- **Mr. N. S. Raghavan** — Chief Executive Officer, Eyecare  
- **Manish Gupta** — Chief Executive Officer, Fragrances & Women’s Bags ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/leadership-team?utm_source=openai))

For context, Ajoy Chawla succeeded C. K. Venkataraman as Managing Director effective **January 1, 2026**. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-05/SE09Successionplan.pdf?utm_source=openai))

retrieval.query: Titan Company latest CEO managing director appointment succession effective date
retrieval.text:
**Titan Company’s Managing Director succession is effective January 1, 2026.**

- **Ajoy Chawla** succeeded **C. K. Venkataraman** as Managing Director.
- Venkataraman retired/superannuated on **December 31, 2025**.
- Chawla, previously CEO of Titan’s Jewellery Division, was appointed Managing Director for a **five-year term starting January 1, 2026**, subject to shareholder approval. ([titancompany.in](https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2025-11/Q2FY26%2520Results.pdf?utm_source=openai))
